<page>
 Kennedy & Johnson LLP
 Sugar Land, TX
 Phone 832-555-5054
 Letter of Representation
8 Mar 2025
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1313
Our client: Lorraine Allen
Date of loss: 6 Mar 2025
Dear Claims Representative:
This letter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the collision that occurred while our client
was maknig a left turn. Our client sustained injuries in this incident and has asked us to handle all matters arising from it. Please
direct all further communication regarding this claim to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, in
writing, or in person.
We request that you provide the bodily injury liability limits of the policy issued to the at-fault driver, alnog with a copy of the
declarations page confirming those limits. Please also confirm whether any other policies may apply.
We further ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes photographs, vehicle data and event
recorder information, repair and total loss records, witness statements, recorded calls, claim file notes, and any surveillance or
dashcam footage. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of these materials while the claim is pending.
We look forward to your prompt written response to each of these requests.
Sincerely,
David Richardson
Kennedy & Johnson LLP
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
